description: Record work done outside the normal cycle. Persists a BUILD HANDOFF and build report before moving the task to Done or In Review; an existing In Progress task moves to In Review. Use for quick fixes, bug patches, or ad-hoc changes. Two phases: pass `mode: "start"` to create the Board task FIRST (In Progress, on the active cycle) with a caller-authored `handoff`, implement, then pass `task_id` to complete it. Does not call the Anthropic API. Internal mechanism: PAPI's own routing calls this to pull already-built work into a cycle, so a contributor never needs to invoke it as a required step.

cycle.description: task-2352: promote this ad-hoc work into a cycle so it shows on the hub and is counted as INJECTED work (distinct from planned). Omit for the default behaviour (an immediate Done task with no cycle). "current" = the active cycle; "next-if-plan-not-run" = the next cycle if the latest already shipped (so between-cycle work is not lost), else current; or an explicit cycle number.

evidence_commit_sha.description: task-4012: full or short SHA of that commit, recorded on the synthesized handoff.

evidence_commit_subject.description: task-4012: subject line of the commit that carried the work (e.g. "feat(task-4004): Backlog: show task creator"). Recorded on the synthesized handoff so the reviewer sees what landed. For hosted callers with no local git.

evidence_diff.description: task-4012: unified diff text of the recorded work (e.g. `git show <sha>`; truncation is fine). Used to derive the changed files when evidence_files is omitted. For hosted callers with no local git.

evidence_files.description: task-4012: changed files of the recorded work (array or a comma/newline-separated string). Needed to SYNTHESIZE a missing BUILD HANDOFF when work is pulled into a cycle. REQUIRED ON THE HOSTED TRANSPORT, which has no git access — without it a pulled-in task carries no handoff and `review_submit` refuses to accept it with no remedy available. Ignored when a local checkout can resolve the diff itself.

handoff.description: task-4049: a caller-authored BUILD HANDOFF — markdown in the BUILD HANDOFF template, or the structured {scope, scopeBoundary, acceptanceCriteria, effort} shape. On `mode: "start"` it is persisted verbatim on the new task (NEVER synthesized). On a `task_id` completion it is attached before the artifact gate, so a task started without one can still be completed honestly.

hold.description: task-2477: held-adhoc. When true, do NOT force-complete or commit to main — record the task In Review pinned to the NEXT cycle (current + 1) so the planner won't re-plan it, and return a branch/PR directive (commit on feat/<task-id>, never main, leave unmerged) so it rides the next cycle's review → release bundled with planned work. One-call replacement for the two-call ad_hoc + board_edit stopgap. Takes precedence over `cycle`/`stage`.

mode.description: task-4049: create-first start phase. `mode: "start"` creates the Board task NOW — status In Progress, source ad_hoc, attached to the active cycle (or the next one when the latest has released) — BEFORE any code is written, so concurrent members see the work while it happens, and returns the created task id plus the exact next step. It does NOT complete the task: implement, then finish with a second `ad_hoc` call passing `task_id`. Omit for the legacy immediate-record behaviour. Do not pass task_id with mode "start".

priority.description: Task priority (default: P2 Medium). Use P1 for important fixes, P0 for critical incidents.

project.description: Project id (UUID) or slug to record this work under, overriding the session project for THIS call only. Must be a project on your account — fails closed otherwise. Use project_switch to change the session default. PASS THIS WHENEVER YOU KNOW WHICH REPO THE SESSION IS IN: on a multi-project account a connection with no project bound cannot be resolved, and PAPI will stop and ask rather than guess.

proposal.description: task-3273, OPTIONAL: propose a Decision or a Convention you settled while doing this work. PAPI never mints one for you — a proposal passing all four admission tests is QUEUED for the owner behind a decision gate, and nothing is written as an Active Decision. YOU apply the four tests; the server routes on your answers and makes no judgement about the content.

body.description: What was decided or settled, and why.

module.description: Optional module scope. Only used when this lands as a Convention.

tests.description: The four admission tests, each answered explicitly. An omitted test is NOT a failed test.

title.description: One line stating the stance or rule.

stage.description: task-2352: where promoted work lands. "done" (default) records it as Done + reviewed. "release" lands it In Review so it is reviewed and released WITH the cycle (fold-in) instead of being force-completed. Only meaningful with `cycle`.

task_id.description: Existing task ID to associate this work with (e.g. "task-42"). Appends notes, persists required build evidence, and moves an In Progress task to In Review.

title.description: What was done — becomes the task title (required when creating new task, optional when completing existing via task_id).

type.description: Task type (default: inferred from description — "fix"/"bug" → bug, "research"/"investigate" → research, otherwise task).

name: ad_hoc
